8a13eab606.q: What is Twilio's shared AI infrastructure approach to scale artificial intelligence beyond pilots?
8a13eab606.a: Twilio uses a governed federated build model where every model call goes through one gateway providing routing, cost controls, and privacy controls. Tools and data are accessed through one standard auditable path, and teams share a library of agents, skills, and connectors so teams reuse what others have already built rather than rebuilding it. Enterprise technology owns the platform, trust standards, security, privacy, cost tracking, and telemetry, while business leaders retain flexibility to build their own use cases within inference budgets.

28576e59b3.q: How does Twilio's Customer Zero program test AI products internally before customer release?
28576e59b3.a: Twilio's Customer Zero program operates on three pillars: experimentation on the platform with feedback and hardening; creating value through the platform with quantified measurement; and enabling customers with reference architectures and blueprints. As CIO, Shweta leads using Twilio's own products and real internal workflows to test and harden them before customers access them, providing credibility when discussing reference architectures with other CXOs.

cfe9180738.q: What governance approach does Twilio use to keep AI governance pace aligned with rapid AI innovation?
cfe9180738.a: Twilio redesigned third-party risk management for AI by making gates for proof of concepts lighter than gates for production. The company implemented guardrails into the platform through a single auditable path to all tools and data, and is developing more robust runtime and agentic identity controls. Until agentic identity and runtime controls are mature, Twilio keeps agentic building contained using existing technology to avoid slowing innovation.

a613cc3f48.q: How does Twilio manage agent sprawl as a form of shadow IT while maintaining experimentation?
a613cc3f48.a: Twilio uses a three-tier approach: everyone gets better search and a personal AI assistant with capped costs; teams with repeat work get agentic workflows through shared skills and an AI marketplace; and a center of excellence cohort of builders creates shareable team assets within guardrails. This prevents the same AI solution in a thousand different flavors from being built across the company while allowing controlled experimentation.

2529d2a8ff.q: What security and compliance measures does Twilio implement for AI-driven agent transactions in regulated industries?
2529d2a8ff.a: Twilio uses its own identity suite of products to prevent fraudulent agentic signups and unauthorized agent hijacking of financial transactions. The company implements guardrails to identify what is human versus agentic, applies heightened scrutiny and security to agentic interactions, and ensures immutability with audit traces for every transaction and definite identification of who performs transactions to meet regulatory compliance requirements.
